note: Curated learning resources for the career engine. Every URL is checked by scripts/check_learning_links.py (results in resource_checks.json); only 'ok' links are recommended. 'start' is the level a learner should already have (none = no prior use); 'reach' is the level the resource can take them to with practice. 'focus' is practical (hands-on), theory (concepts) or mixed. No durations, ratings or prices are stored: we can't verify them and they change.
